ops.body: - A journey carried by the session (decision 0201, OJ48-OJ51), left for later: no check in a browser of the way on foot within reach of a town (OJ30), of a town let go by driving past (unit only), of "Leave this town out" or of the line between towns (OJ26, OJ51), since the test world holds one town with anything in it; a journey resumed in a later session, kept or shared; `sessionTrace` reads the whole trace once when the walk screen opens (n: up to 30k fixes, thinned to a tenth); "Pass by" and putting the plan away last only while the screen does, by design (nothing stores reached or passed)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone, plan a journey toward a town an hour's drive away with two or more towns in it; leave one town out on the page; tap Start at home and drive; watch the walk screen in each of these: before the first town, in it on foot, driving past the second without stopping, after "Pass by", after locking the phone for the drive, after killing and reopening the app mid-drive; then Stop. **Expect:** the session records from Start, the drive included; the bar names the town ahead with its distance in two rows that never cover the capture stack; "Open in Maps" opens the town in the maps app; within about 2 km of a town the way on foot through its stops appears once and its stops are named only on arrival; a town left behind or driven past is never named again and nothing is marked done; the plan survives the app being killed; after Stop, the next session shows no bar (OJ28-OJ31, OJ33, OJ48, OJ49)
